text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The new year has begun. Mejiro Bright 
enters the Senior tier today. An important 
year is about to start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came for Hatsumode to pray for a great 
leap forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. The line for the New Year's 
shrine visit is hardly moving at all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Do you think we'll be moving by the time I 
finish counting the pine needles again~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The line wasn't moving at all. It 
wasn't just slow— it didn't budge a single 
inch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Dear Trainer~. Haste makes waste, 
as they say~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's wait patiently here.~ I'm sure it'll 
start flowing smoothly before long~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had reached my limit. If I waited any 
longer, the sun would set...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it will still take some 
time~ In that case, Trainer-sama, how 
about we do this~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The main shrine is in sight, so why don't 
we start by making a quick wish right 
here~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You know~, just like you have appetizers 
before the main meal, right~?
choice_data_list:
Like a light hors d'oeuvre... or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I believe the gods will provide a 
little extra service for all the waiting 
we did~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There's no use idling away the time 
like this. Just to kill time, I decided to 
try praying for something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-sama, let us make a wish 
together~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our two hearts beat as one. The wish that 
spilled unbidden from our lips was...
choice_data_list: I hope this line moves quickly...
Hopefully the god will come to us instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I hope you sleep well while waiting~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether by divine grace or sheer personal 
ability, Mejiro Bright dozed off in the 
blink of an eye. And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaaawn*... *sigh*~ I slept so well~. It 
feels as though God granted my wish~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Trainer? Where might this be? It 
seems I have been spirited away~.
choice_data_list: ...I carried it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You carried me...? Oh my, Trainer-sama. 
Thank you very much~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having slept soundly in a quiet spot, 
Mejiro Bright seems to have regained some 
of her energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I hope the line moves quickly~.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, close the gap! There's space 
wide open, keep pushing forward!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ......Huh? Oh dear~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A miracle happened. As if our prayers were 
heard, the line moved forward rapidly, 
reaching the shrine pavilion in no time... 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~, being thrust before the altar out 
of nowhere, I couldn't think of a single 
thing~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The more I think about it, the more my 
head just goes all fuzzy~.
choice_data_list: So, what did you wish for in the end?
So, what did you end up wishing for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In the end~ nothing came to mind, so this 
is what I asked for~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I wished that, 'May all sorts of things 
get better~.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a fluffy, gentle wish, so very 
typical of Mejiro Bright. Even so, I feel 
like quite a few things have improved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I hope God will come to us instead~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If they'd just come over here themselves, 
it'd be over in a flash. Just as that 
wicked thought crossed my mind...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ayaya, what is the matter, Miss Bright? 
Could it be you are visiting the shrine 
for the New Year?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's go somewhere less 
crowded! I'll show you the way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Lady Fukukitaru~. I look forward 
to working with you~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So, you see, if you want to pray, a 
mountain stream like this works just as 
well. There are water gods in the rivers 
too, after all~"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The myriad gods dwell all over nature! 
Let's have fun going around praying to 
them!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. Not only do we get to offer plenty 
of prayers, but we also get to go on a 
stroll~. Lady Fukukitaru is truly a 
goddess of good fortune~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A god-like, benevolent Umamusume gave a 
New Year's power spot tour. I learned a 
lot of useful knowledge, too.
